title: 3DO DevBench — Debug
subtitle: Spectral Keep running in the patched Opera emulator · ./3do devbench · :3330

items.label: Session picker
items.text: Every running emulator session (DevBench's own, ./3do run windows, headless MCP sessions); every tab shows the one chosen here.

items.label: Status pills
items.text: Run mode (running / paused), guest frame counter and CPU state (running, or HALTED in red at a breakpoint).

items.label: Run controls
items.text: Run (real time), Turbo, Pause, +1 frame / +60, CPU halt (debugger freeze), Reset and Reboot for the selected session.

items.label: Stop banner
items.text: Shown whenever the CPU stops (breakpoint, watchpoint, halt): why and where, with continue buttons.

items.label: Registers
items.text: r0–r15 and CPSR; pc and lr symbolised (MCP: emu_regs).

items.label: Disassembly
items.text: ARM disassembly around the PC with symbol offsets; => marks the PC, click a line to toggle a breakpoint (MCP: emu_disasm).

items.label: Break / watch / trace
items.text: Type a symbol or address: + break stops there (here hud_draw), + trace logs calls with r0–r3, + watch stops on memory access (MCP: emu_break / emu_watch / emu_trace).

items.label: Symbols
items.text: Program symbols at their relocated runtime addresses, with break and mem shortcuts (MCP: emu_symbols).

items.label: SWI snoop
items.text: Every system call the game and OS made, named from the SDK headers, with counts, caller and arguments (MCP: emu_syscalls).

items.label: Profiler
items.text: Samples the PC inside N frames and shows CPU share per function, OS/ROM and idle grouped (MCP: emu_profile).

items.label: Crashes
items.text: Aborts and exceptions reported by the OS, with registers and log context (MCP: emu_crashes).
